blocks.body: Operators steer camera views with head motion from AR glasses, bring in drone feeds where needed, and rely on AI to detect threats and alert proactively rather than waiting for someone to notice.

blocks.text: AR-powered solutions designed to improve efficiency across industries

SmartSurveillance is one of four solutions on the Smart Solutions Platform from Purview Technologies, the group’s AI and XR company. The platform puts AR smart glasses, real-time captioning and translation, and Purview’s vision and voice AI into the hands of frontline teams, so the people doing the work see what they need, hands free, and the people supporting them can be anywhere.

items.title: Head-motion camera control
items.body: Operators pan and switch remote camera views by looking, hands free, from a control room or on patrol.

items.title: AI threat detection
items.body: Intrusion, loitering, left objects, crowd behaviour and safety-zone breaches detected in real time.

items.title: Proactive alerting
items.body: Alerts routed to the right people with the clip and location, before an incident escalates.

items.title: Optional drone support
items.body: Drone feeds integrated for perimeter sweeps, large sites and incident response.

items.title: Multi-site view
items.body: Many sites and camera estates in one operator experience.

items.title: Evidence and audit
items.body: Incidents recorded, tagged and exportable for investigation.
